_terms: Each position carries MOCK contract `terms` (HYPOTHETICAL, invented for the demo; not any real deal's documents) for the covenant desk. Every trigger has evidence.direct / evidence.indirect = risk tags from youfin/risk_tags.py; requires_text = a text rule that must also match the evidence (e.g. 'filing'); observable=false = cannot be seen in public news; max_status caps a contestable clause (MAC); derived_from = trips when any listed trigger trips ('STE-*' = prefix).
_proxies: Each counterparty lists liquid public proxies for the market desk: role = exposed_lender | peer | customer | sector_etf | credit | market; vs = sector ETF used as a second abnormal-return benchmark; relevance (optional, 0-1) overrides the role default in hedge ranking.

positions.name: Tricolor senior warehouse facility
positions.collateral: subprime used-auto retail installment contracts (TX, CA)
positions.notes: 85% advance rate; borrowing base reported monthly; Tricolor is also servicer.

terms._hypothetical: MOCK terms invented for this demo; not the documents of any real facility.

borrowing_base.basis: outstanding principal balance of Eligible Receivables
borrowing_base.availability: min(commitment, 85% x Eligible Receivables) minus advances outstanding; a borrowing-base deficiency must be repaid within 2 business days
eligibility: no more than 30 days past due
certificate of title or electronic lien record held by the Custodian naming the Lender (or the Custodian as its agent) as lienholder
not sold, pledged or subject to any lien other than the Lender's
obligor resident in TX or CA; APR within the state cap
complete contract file listed on the custodial receipt
draw_conditions: no Default or Event of Default
representations true, incl. sole-lien and title reps
borrowing base certificate dated within 30 days

reporting_covenants.label: Borrowing base certificate + data tape
reporting_covenants.description: Monthly borrowing base certificate, servicer report and loan-level data tape by the 15th; an interim certificate within 2 business days of the Lender's request.
reporting_covenants.consequence: Event of Default; advances blocked while late

reporting_covenants.label: Notice of default / other-creditor remedies
reporting_covenants.description: Notice within 2 business days of any Default, any other creditor's default notice or exercise of remedies, and any governmental investigation.

review_events.label: Other-creditor disclosure (review event)
review_events.description: Any other lender, securitization party or regulator publicly discloses material exposure to, an impairment of, or remedies against the Borrower or Servicer.
review_events.consequence: Borrower delivers an interim borrowing base certificate, data tape and written explanation within 2 business days; further advances conditional on a satisfactory review; field exam at the Borrower's cost

events_of_default.label: Payment / borrowing-base deficiency
events_of_default.description: Failure to pay interest or fees within 2 business days, or to repay a borrowing-base deficiency within 2 business days.
events_of_default.consequence: acceleration at the Lender's option; default interest

events_of_default.label: Collateral rep breach / double pledge
events_of_default.description: Any pledged contract is subject to another lien (double-pledged), was not originated as represented, or its title is not held by the Custodian with the Lender as lienholder; or fraud / material misrepresentation in any borrowing base certificate.
events_of_default.cure: none for fraud; 10 business days to repurchase an inadvertently ineligible contract
events_of_default.consequence: acceleration; affected contracts leave the borrowing base immediately

events_of_default.label: Insolvency event
events_of_default.description: Borrower, Servicer or Parent files (or has filed against it, undismissed for 60 days) a bankruptcy petition, admits in writing it cannot pay its debts, or takes corporate action to authorize either.
events_of_default.consequence: automatic acceleration and termination of the commitment; from the petition date the automatic stay (11 U.S.C. 362) limits enforcement

events_of_default.label: Cessation of business
events_of_default.description: Borrower or Servicer suspends originations or servicing, or furloughs substantially all staff, for 3 or more business days.
events_of_default.consequence: acceleration at the Lender's option; also a Servicer Termination Event

events_of_default.label: Judgments / governmental proceedings
events_of_default.description: Unstayed judgments over $5M for 30 days, or an indictment or governmental enforcement action against the Borrower, Servicer or senior management.
events_of_default.cure: 30 days for judgments; none for an indictment

cross_default.label: Cross-default / other lenders' remedies
cross_default.description: Default or acceleration under, or any creditor's exercise of remedies (seizure, foreclosure, cash sweep) against, other Indebtedness of the Borrower or Parent above $5M, incl. other warehouse lines and securitizations.
cross_default.cure: none for acceleration or remedies; 10 business days for a payment default on other debt

mac_clause.label: Material adverse change
mac_clause.description: A material adverse change in the business, the collateral, or the ability of the Borrower or Servicer to perform, in the Lender's reasonable judgment; also a condition to each advance.
mac_clause.consequence: draw condition fails; an EoD only if the MAC is proven, which courts rarely accept on its own: rely on specific defaults and reserve rights

servicer.backup_servicer: warm backup servicer (unnamed): monthly data-file mapping; hot transition within 30 days of notice; costs paid from collections ahead of interest

termination_events.label: Servicer insolvency
termination_events.consequence: Lender may terminate the servicer and appoint the backup servicer; after a petition, ipso facto termination generally needs stay relief

termination_events.label: Failure to remit collections
termination_events.description: Servicer fails to deposit collections into the collection account within 2 business days of receipt.

termination_events.label: Servicer stops servicing
termination_events.description: Servicer suspends or abandons servicing, or loses the staff or systems to service.

termination_events.label: Servicer fraud / misapplied collections
termination_events.description: Fraud, misapplication of collections or material misstatement in any servicer report.

termination_events.label: Portfolio performance triggers
termination_events.description: 60+ day delinquencies above 12% or annualized net losses above 15% (3-month average).
termination_events.consequence: Servicer Termination Event; advance rate steps down to 75%

cash_management.lockbox: Obligor payments go to a lockbox and collection account at the Collection Bank in the Borrower's name, under a springing deposit account control agreement (DACA) in the Lender's favor; until activation, funds sweep daily to the Borrower.

springing_dominion.label: Springing cash dominion trigger
springing_dominion.description: Springs on any Event of Default, Servicer Termination Event or cross-default (or availability below 10% of the borrowing base for 3 business days).
springing_dominion.consequence: Lender may deliver a notice of exclusive control to the Collection Bank; collections then sweep daily to a Lender-controlled account and pay down advances

cash_management.preference_consideration: For counsel: sweeps and paydowns in the 90 days before a petition (1 year for insiders) can face preference claims (11 U.S.C. 547). Collections on collateral of a fully secured lender are generally not preferential, but double-pledged collateral makes 'fully secured' uncertain.

collateral_custody.titles: Custodian holds original certificates of title / electronic lien records with the Lender (or the Custodian as its agent) noted as lienholder, plus the retail installment contract files; custodial receipt at each funding; monthly exception report.
collateral_custody.ucc: UCC-1 against the Borrower SPV (Delaware) covering all receivables and proceeds; UCC-1 against Tricolor (Texas) covering the sale of receivables to the SPV.
double_pledge_checks: reconcile VINs in the data tape against custodial receipts and title records
UCC / lien search for competing financing statements
compare VIN lists with other warehouse lenders through counsel

positions.name: Tricolor Auto Securitization Trust 2025-2, Class B notes
positions.notes: Held position in a real public deal name; size invented.

terms._hypothetical: MOCK terms invented for this demo; the deal name is real, the position size and every term below are not taken from its documents.

deal.class: Class B (mezzanine), subordinate to Class A
deal.indenture_trustee: Indenture Trustee named in the deal (unnamed here)
deal.backup_servicer: backup servicer named in the deal (verify in the documents)

noteholder_rights.acts_through: the Indenture Trustee only; a Class B holder has no direct enforcement right against the servicer or the sponsor
noteholder_rights.controlling_class: Class A while outstanding, then Class B
noteholder_rights.direction_threshold: holders of a majority of the Controlling Class outstanding principal
noteholder_rights.servicer_removal: the Indenture Trustee may, and at the direction of a majority of the Controlling Class shall, terminate the servicer after a Servicer Termination Event
noteholder_rights.class_b_alone: cannot direct the trustee or remove the servicer while Class A is outstanding
noteholder_rights.no_action_clause: suit only if holders of 25% or more of the Controlling Class request the trustee in writing, offer indemnity, and the trustee does not act within 60 days
noteholder_rights.amendments: changes to payment terms need each affected holder; other amendments a majority of each class
noteholder_rights.information: monthly servicer report, trustee notices, investor reporting site

events_of_default.label: Indenture event of default
events_of_default.description: Failure to pay interest on the Controlling Class within 5 business days, principal at final maturity, or an insolvency of the Issuer (trust). A sponsor/servicer bankruptcy is NOT itself an indenture default: the trust is bankruptcy-remote.
events_of_default.consequence: acceleration at the direction of a majority of the Controlling Class; Class B interest is subordinated

servicer.backup_servicer: named in the deal; transition on the Indenture Trustee's notice

termination_events.label: Servicer insolvency
termination_events.consequence: trustee may (at Controlling Class direction shall) terminate the servicer; after a petition, ipso facto termination generally needs bankruptcy-court relief

termination_events.label: Failure to deposit collections
termination_events.description: Servicer fails to deposit collections into the trust collection account within 2 business days.

termination_events.label: Servicer stops servicing
termination_events.description: Servicer suspends servicing or loses the staff or systems to service.

termination_events.label: Servicer fraud / misreporting
termination_events.description: Fraud or material misstatement in servicer reports, or misapplied collections.

performance_triggers.label: Cumulative net loss trigger
performance_triggers.description: Cumulative net losses above the schedule (e.g. 12% by month 12); the waterfall turns fully sequential, deferring Class B principal.
performance_triggers.consequence: sequential pay; Class B principal deferred until Class A is repaid

sponsor_reps.label: Sponsor rep breach (repurchase)
sponsor_reps.description: Receivables that were ineligible when sold to the trust (fictitious, double-pledged, not perfected) must be repurchased by the sponsor.
sponsor_reps.consequence: repurchase claim against the sponsor, only as good as the sponsor's credit

cash_management.collection_account: segregated trust account in the Indenture Trustee's name
cash_management.servicer_remittance: within 2 business days of receipt: collections sit with the servicer meanwhile (commingling risk if it fails)
cash_management.waterfall: pro rata principal until a performance trigger, then sequential

collateral_custody.titles: certificates of title held by the custodian named in the deal, lien noted in the trust's (or its designee's) favor
collateral_custody.true_sale: receivables sold by the sponsor to the depositor and then the trust; true-sale and non-consolidation opinions at closing

positions.name: Auto-parts supplier receivables facility
positions.collateral: invoices owed by large auto-parts retailers
positions.notes: Receivables originated by First Brands Group.

terms._hypothetical: MOCK terms invented for this demo; not the documents of any real facility.

parties.seller_servicer: First Brands Group and its selling subsidiaries
parties.account_debtors: large auto-parts retailers that owe the invoices

purchase_terms.purchase_price: face value less a discount for expected days outstanding; 90% paid at purchase
purchase_terms.deferred_purchase_price: 10% of face, paid after the invoice is collected (first-loss reserve for dilution)
purchase_terms.recourse: no recourse for an account debtor's credit; full recourse for dilution, disputes and breached reps
eligibility: invoice for goods already delivered, no more than 90 days from invoice date
not disputed, not subject to setoff or credit notes
not sold, factored or pledged to anyone else
account debtor not notified of any other assignment
purchase_conditions: no Review Event or Termination Event
purchase_terms.true_sale: intended true sale; UCC-1 filed against the Seller (a sale of accounts is perfected by filing)
purchase_terms.notification: undisclosed: account debtors are not told of the sale until a Termination Event

reporting_covenants.label: Weekly servicer report / notices
reporting_covenants.description: Weekly servicer report, aging and collections reconciliation; notice within 2 business days of any Termination Event or of any other financier's claim to purchased invoices.

review_events.label: Review event (financing practices)
review_events.description: Any third-party review, audit or public report questioning the Seller's receivables or supply-chain financing or off-balance-sheet obligations; auditor resignation; restatement.
review_events.consequence: Purchaser may stop buying; Seller delivers within 3 business days a schedule of ALL receivables financings and invoice-level data; Purchaser may verify every outstanding invoice with account debtors at the Seller's cost

termination_events.label: Seller / servicer insolvency
termination_events.description: Seller or servicer files (or has filed against it, undismissed 60 days) a bankruptcy petition or admits it cannot pay its debts.
termination_events.consequence: facility terminates; from the petition date the automatic stay applies and the debtor may claim the purchased invoices as estate property

termination_events.label: Double-factoring / fraud
termination_events.description: A purchased invoice was also sold, factored or pledged to someone else (double-factoring), is fictitious, or had already been paid; any fraud by the Seller.
termination_events.consequence: Termination Event; Seller must repurchase affected invoices at face

termination_events.label: Servicer default / goes silent
termination_events.description: Servicer fails to remit collections within 2 business days, to deliver reports or to answer information requests, or suspends operations.
termination_events.consequence: Termination Event; Purchaser may replace the servicer and notify account debtors

termination_events.label: Cross-default / creditor standstill
termination_events.description: Default, acceleration or exercise of remedies under Seller indebtedness above $25M, or a payment standstill / forbearance with its lenders.

termination_events.label: Dilution / default ratios
termination_events.description: Dilution above 5% or defaulted receivables above 3% (3-month average), or an account debtor concentration breach.

mac_clause.label: Material adverse change
mac_clause.description: A material adverse change in the Seller's business or in the collectability of the purchased invoices; also a condition to each purchase.
mac_clause.consequence: purchase condition fails (purchases are discretionary anyway); hard to prove as a termination event on its own

cash_management.collections: Account debtors pay into a Seller-owned collection account under a springing DACA in the Purchaser's favor; the servicer remits weekly.

springing_dominion.label: Springing cash dominion / notification
springing_dominion.consequence: daily remittance; DACA activation; the Purchaser may notify account debtors to pay it directly (UCC 9-406: after notice, paying the Seller no longer discharges the debt)

cash_management.preference_consideration: For counsel: if the sale is recharacterized as a secured loan, collections redirected in the 90 days before a petition can face preference claims (11 U.S.C. 547).

collateral_custody.ucc: UCC-1 against the Seller and each selling subsidiary covering the sold accounts; first-to-file decides priority if invoices were sold twice
collateral_custody.invoice_verification: 10% sample confirmed with account debtors each quarter; 100% after a Review Event
collateral_custody.account_debtor_notification: notices of assignment pre-signed and held in escrow; sent only after a Termination Event
double_factoring_checks: confirm each invoice directly with the account debtor (amount, due date, no other notice of assignment, not yet paid)
UCC search for other financing statements covering accounts
compare invoice numbers with other financiers through counsel
